title: La Navidad founded
description: Columbus's flagship Santa María is wrecked on the north coast and its timbers are used for the first Spanish settlement in the Americas.

title: Jaragua massacre
description: The governor Nicolás de Ovando kills the Taíno chiefs of Xaragua and has their ruler Anacaona hanged, ending Taíno rule in the west of the island.

title: French settle Tortuga
description: French and English adventurers settle the island of Tortuga, which becomes a base of buccaneers and the start of the French colony.

title: Cap-Français founded
description: The French found the port that becomes the richest town of the colony.

title: Treaty of Ryswick
description: Spain recognises French possession of the western third of Hispaniola as the colony of Saint-Domingue.

title: Port-au-Prince founded
description: The French found Port-au-Prince, which becomes the capital of the colony and later of Haiti.

title: Execution of Mackandal
description: The maroon leader François Mackandal, accused of plotting to poison the planters, is burned at the stake.

title: Bois Caïman ceremony
description: Enslaved people meet at a Vodou ceremony to plan the rising that begins the Haitian Revolution a week later.

title: Slavery abolished in the north
description: The French commissioner Léger-Félicité Sonthonax proclaims the freedom of the slaves of the northern province.

title: Louverture's constitution
description: Toussaint Louverture issues a constitution that makes him governor for life and bans slavery for good.

title: Death of Toussaint Louverture
description: Louverture dies in a French prison after being seized and deported by Napoleon's expedition.

title: Battle of Vertières
description: The army of Jean-Jacques Dessalines defeats the last French force, which leaves the island.

title: Independence declared
description: Dessalines proclaims the independence of Haiti, the first state founded by former slaves.

title: Assassination of Dessalines
description: Emperor Jacques I is killed by his own officers, and the country splits into a northern state and a southern republic.

title: Kingdom of Haiti
description: Henri Christophe makes himself king of northern Haiti, where he builds the Citadelle Laferrière.

title: Indemnity to France
description: Charles X recognises Haiti's independence in return for 150 million francs for the former planters, a debt that burdens the country for generations.

title: Cap-Haïtien earthquake
description: An earthquake and tsunami destroy Cap-Haïtien and other northern towns.

title: Soulouque made emperor
description: President Faustin Soulouque has himself proclaimed Emperor Faustin I and rules until 1859.

title: United States occupation begins
description: American marines land after the killing of President Vilbrun Guillaume Sam and stay for nineteen years.

title: United States occupation ends
description: The last American marines leave Haiti.

title: François Duvalier elected
description: The doctor known as Papa Doc wins the presidency and builds a dictatorship that his family holds for 29 years.

title: Death of François Duvalier
description: François Duvalier dies and his nineteen-year-old son Jean-Claude succeeds him as president for life.

title: Fall of Jean-Claude Duvalier
description: Jean-Claude Duvalier flees to France after months of protests, ending the family's rule.

title: Aristide elected
description: The priest Jean-Bertrand Aristide wins the first free presidential election in Haiti's history.

title: Coup against Aristide
description: The army under Raoul Cédras overthrows Aristide after less than eight months in office.

title: Operation Uphold Democracy
description: American troops land under a United Nations mandate and the military rulers step down, allowing Aristide to return.

title: Aristide ousted
description: Aristide leaves the country as rebels approach the capital, and a United Nations force follows.

title: Earthquake of 2010
description: An earthquake destroys much of Port-au-Prince and nearby towns and kills more than a hundred thousand people.

title: Cholera outbreak
description: Cholera, brought by United Nations peacekeepers, breaks out along the Artibonite River and goes on to kill about ten thousand people.

title: Hurricane Matthew
description: A category 4 hurricane strikes the south-western peninsula, killing hundreds of people.
